name: full_explicit
yaml:
version: 1
device:
  serial: "AM4NBB5C23001691"
  prefer_usb: true
  auto_connect: false
  server_port: 1235
  known: ["AM4NBB5C23001691", "192.168.1.9:5555"]
  macs:
    "192.168.1.9:5555": "88:a4:79:1a:2b:3c"
placement:
  monitor: "\\\\\\\\.\\\\DISPLAY2"
  edge: left
  span_start: -2560
  span_end: 0
  offset: 0.25
  align: one_to_one
  corner_priority: bottom
layouts:
  devices:
    am4nbb5c23001691:
      portrait:
        edge: top
        align: center
        span_start: 0
        span_end: 1234
        offset: 0.75
      landscape:
        monitor: "\\\\\\\\.\\\\DISPLAY1"
        edge: right
        span_start: 0
        span_end: 1600
        offset: 0.5
        align: proportional
        corner_priority: ""
    "192.168.1.9:5555":
      landscape:
        edge: bottom
        offset: 1.0
motion:
  gain: 1.75
  report_hz: 500
  hid_clamp: 64
  entry_margin_px: 4
  exit_overflow_px: 100
  debounce_ms: 200
  arm_px: 20
  arm_window_ms: 100
  edge_band_px: 2
  boundary_inset_px: 8
keyboard:
  forward: false
  suppress_pc: false
  layout: de
  passthrough_keys: []
hotkeys:
  toggle: "Ctrl+Shift+F9"
  panic: "Ctrl+Shift+F12"
ui:
  language: en_US
  theme: "Light"
  tray_notifications: false
  close_to_tray: true
misc:
  clipboard_sync: false
  keep_screen_on: false
  restore_pointer_speed: -1
  forward_audio: true

layouts:
  devices:
    "":
      landscape:
        edge: right
    SERIAL1:
      landscape:
        edge: diagonal
        offset: 3.0
        align: stretch
      portrait: oops
    SERIAL2:

        edge: right
      landscape:
        monitor: ""
    ABC:
      landscape:
        edge: top
    abc:

        edge: bottom
